# Widdx Framework

> A zero-code PHP 8.1+ MVC framework: the programmer writes the fewest possible
> lines. One line `resource('posts')->public()` produces a complete CRUD web app;
> `authRoutes()` produces full authentication; `make:crud` produces model +
> migration + route from one shell command. Runs on shared hosting without
> composer or a terminal.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the PRIMARY document — the five-command recipe, the binding LAWS,
  the file map, the definition of done, and a router to `.agents/*.md` (the reference layer:
  inference rules, API list, pitfalls, expert notes). Read AGENTS.md first, then one `.agents/` file.
- [README.md](README.md): human-oriented guide with full worked examples.
- [core/helpers.php](core/helpers.php): every global helper function, documented inline.
- [routes/web.php](routes/web.php): smallest possible working app (study it first).
- [app/Models/User.php](app/Models/User.php): canonical model shape (fillable + rules).
- [tests/integration.php](tests/integration.php): executable specification of all
  framework behavior over real HTTP.

## Key facts (the handbook itself is AGENTS.md + the .agents/ layer it routes to)

- Project = the framework folder. No build step. Composer optional (fallback autoloader).
- Conventions over configuration: tables, FKs, form fields, selects, pivots, policies and view
  overrides are INFERRED from names (full list: `.agents/07-inference.md`).
- Templates run in the GLOBAL namespace — use helpers (`auth()`, `e()`), never bare classes.
- Validation rules drive server checks AND the auto-generated HTML form.
- CRUD pages are FAIL-CLOSED: `resource('x')` without `->public()` (and without a policy) sends
  guests to `/login` and gives logged-in users 403. Generators emit `->public()`.
- `php widdx test` = unit + integration suite (real HTTP, CSRF, auth, SMTP, CLI); it refuses to
  start when a PHP PDO driver is missing, so env problems never look like bugs.

## The laws bind (AGENTS.md PART 2A; callable API: `.agents/12-api-surface.md`)

- NEVER edit `core/` from inside a project. App code lives in `app/`, `views/`, `routes/`, `database/`.
- Call only documented names: `Model` has no `__callStatic`, so a guessed name is a fatal error.
- Task order: name the files → generator → `migrate` → restart `serve` → prove it with `curl -i`.
  A 404 right after an edit is the stale dev server, not broken code.
